String.string:
[EN] The Poisoner will arrive shortly.
[ES] El Poisoner llegará en breve.

[EN] The Poisoner has appeared.
[ES] El Poisoner ha aparecido.

[EN] Welcome, maggots. This location is already under our control. Hahaha!
[ES] Bienvenidos, gusanos. Este lugar ya está bajo nuestro control. ¡Jajaja!

[EN] Until the Abomination has destroyed the engine room, I’ve got time to play with you.
[ES] Hasta que el Abomination destruya la sala de máquinas, tengo tiempo para jugar con ustedes.

[EN] Come on, if you’ve got the guts!
[ES] ¡Vamos, si tienen las agallas!

[EN] There’ll be nothing left of amateurs like you.
[ES] No quedará nada de aficionados como ustedes.

[EN] He seems not to be managing on his own.
[ES] Parece que no se las arregla solo.

[EN] Shall I intervene?
[ES] ¿Debo intervenir?

[EN] The Abomination is moving toward the engine room to destroy the Floating Stone.
[ES] La Abomination se dirige hacia la sala de máquinas para destruir la Floating Stone.

[EN] The Poisoner has arrived!
[ES] ¡The Poisoner ha llegado!

[EN] Your journey ends here.
[ES] Tu viaje termina aquí.

[EN] The Poisoner will annihilate you!
[ES] ¡The Poisoner te aniquilará!

[EN] The Poisoner receives increased defense from the warrior.
[ES] The Poisoner recibe mayor defensa del guerrero.

[EN] The Poisoner receives increased attack from the sorcerer.
[ES] The Poisoner recibe mayor ataque del sorcerer.

[EN] The Poisoner receives long-lasting healing from the mystic.
[ES] The Poisoner recibe curación duradera del místico.

[EN] You’ll go down with this ship!
[ES] ¡Te hundirás con este barco!

[EN] Defeat the archdevans before the Poisoner comes!
[ES] ¡Derrota a los archdevans antes de que llegue The Poisoner!

[EN] All Floating Stones have been destroyed. The sky cruiser is going down.
[ES] Todas las Floating Stones han sido destruidas. El crucero estelar se está cayendo.

[EN] A Floating Stone has been destroyed! (1/8)
[ES] ¡Una Floating Stone ha sido destruida! (1/8)

[EN] A Floating Stone has been destroyed! (2/8)
[ES] ¡Una Floating Stone ha sido destruida! (2/8)

[EN] A Floating Stone has been destroyed! (3/8)
[ES] ¡Una Floating Stone ha sido destruida! (3/8)

[EN] A Floating Stone has been destroyed! (4/8)
[ES] ¡Una Floating Stone ha sido destruida! (4/8)

[EN] A Floating Stone has been destroyed! (5/8)
[ES] ¡Una Floating Stone has been destruida! (5/8)

[EN] Worship the darkness!
[ES] ¡Adora la oscuridad!

[EN] Go ahead and try to dodge my attack!
[ES] ¡Intenta esquivar mi ataque!

[EN] Something is approaching from the sky.
[ES] Algo se acerca desde el cielo.

[EN] Alkus screams in pain.
[ES] Alkus grita de dolor.

[EN] Protected the Floating Stone!
[ES] ¡Protegido el Floating Stone!

[EN] You can’t escape!
[ES] ¡No puedes escapar!

[EN] A Floating Stone has been destroyed! (6/8)
[ES] ¡Se ha destruido un Floating Stone! (6/8)

[EN] A Floating Stone has been destroyed! (7/8)
[ES] ¡Se ha destruido un Floating Stone! (7/8)

[EN] My flames are enough for you!
[ES] ¡Mis llamas son suficientes para ti!

[EN] What… My flames!
[ES] ¡Qué... Mis llamas!

[EN] The sky cruiser is in flames.
[ES] El crucero estelar está en llamas.

[EN] A strange effect rises from the deck.
[ES] Un efecto extraño surge de la cubierta.

[EN] The fire keeps on spreading further.
[ES] El fuego sigue extendiéndose.

[EN] Will!
[ES] ¡Te!

[EN] Obliterate you!
[ES] ¡Aniquilaré!

[EN] I’ll show you true power!
[ES] ¡Te mostraré el verdadero poder!

[EN] Enough gas has accumulated in the pile of bodies.
[ES] Se ha acumulado suficiente gas en el montón de cuerpos.

[EN] The Abomination is starting to absorb mana.
[ES] The Abomination está empezando a absorber maná.

[EN] The Abomination is starting to absorb HP.
[ES] The Abomination está empezando a absorber HP.

[EN] You are losing HP.
[ES] Estás perdiendo HP.

[EN] You are losing more HP.
[ES] Estás perdiendo más HP.

[EN] I’ll leave you to Putrion’s tender mercies… I have an engine room to destroy…
[ES] Te dejaré en manos de Putrion... Tengo una sala de máquinas que destruir...

[EN] You’ll… not go one step further!
[ES] ¡No darás... ni un paso más!

[EN] Exterminate these pests!
[ES] ¡Extermina estas plagas!

[EN] Putrion will be summoned in 10 sec.
[ES] Putrion será invocado en 10 seg.

[EN] Putrion’s aura shields the demokrons and archdevans.
[ES] El aura de Putrion protege a los demokrons y archdevans.

[EN] The Ancient God’s Blessing will activate in 30 seconds.
[ES] La bendición del Dios antiguo se activará en 30 segundos.

[EN] The Ancient God’s Blessing is now active. (1/3)
[ES] La bendición del Dios antiguo ya está activa. (1/3)

[EN] The entrance will be closed in 10 sec.
[ES] La entrada se cerrará en 10 seg.

[EN] Seems I’m one step behind the others. It’s good to know that Darkan’s been defeated.
[ES] Parece que estoy un paso por detrás de los demás. Es bueno saber que Darkan ha sido derrotado.

[EN] Well, since Darkan no longer poses a threat, things aren’t looking too good with the sky cruiser.
[ES] Bueno, ya que Darkan ya no representa una amenaza, las cosas no pintan muy bien con el crucero aéreo.

[EN] The engineers say we can’t fly like this. We’ll have to go back for maintenance.
[ES] Los ingenieros dicen que no podemos volar así. Tendremos que volver para mantenimiento.

[EN] You there! My master wants you to suffer.
[ES] ¡Tú ahí! Mi amo quiere que sufras.

[EN] I’ll teach you a lesson as only Lakan would himself!
[ES] ¡Te daré una lección como solo Lakan en persona lo haría!

[EN] You pathetic creatures…
[ES] Criaturas patéticas...

[EN] It’s… not over yet…
[ES] Aún... no ha terminado...

[EN] The Ancient God’s Blessing is now active. (2/3)
[ES] La bendición del Dios antiguo ya está activa. (2/3)

[EN] The Ancient God’s Blessing is now active. (3/3)
[ES] La bendición del Dios antiguo ya está activa. (3/3)

[EN] The flames are spreading to the middle of the deck.
[ES] Las llamas se extienden hacia el centro de la cubierta.

[EN] The flames have spread throughout the entire deck.
[ES] Las llamas se han extendido por toda la cubierta.

[EN] Darkan is furious.
[ES] Darkan está furioso.

[EN] Urgh.
[ES] Ugh.

[EN] I’ll teach you what it is to be afraid!
[ES] ¡Te enseñaré lo que es tener miedo!
